summary: Reject unsupported offline card operations and resolve supported alternate identifiers from synced data.
reason: The generic local fallback returned every cached card for filtered search and treated alternate detail keys as primary IDs. Sets get-all also read one record instead of a list.
validated_outcome: Offline tests cover rejected card search, indexed alternate identifiers and v9 mirror migration, local set listing, and version output.
safety: No provider calls in tests; ambiguous alternate identifiers fail explicitly. The public release version remains unchanged.
